verdicts.reason: A keeps the can inside its circle, but GROVE now sits below the headline, the FREE DELIVERY tag floats loose mid-canvas, and the CTA is a tiny pill in the bottom-right corner next to a scattered SUMMER ONLY badge. B empties the circle and pushes the product to the far right edge, so the hero image is cut off from its backdrop. Its CTA is shrunk to badge size inside a cramped row of four pills, which buries it.

A leaves the green circle empty, with the product cut loose at the right edge. Its tiny CTA has no more weight than the three badges crammed into one row under the copy. B keeps the product in its circle with a clean left-to-right flow, but the CTA is squeezed into a tight 2x2 cluster of same-size pills at top right. It doesn't stand out from the badges, and GROVE still sits below the headline.

A is broken: the headline and GROVE run over the empty circle, and the product shrinks to a speck beside the tiny CTA. The badges are scattered at random across the canvas, so there is no grouping. B has the same detached product and empty circle as the other weak layouts, plus a cramped row of buttons and badges with an undersized CTA. Even so, its text is readable and grouped, with no collisions.
